messages:
Alex: starting a lightweight playbook for docs terminology + snippet hygiene. goal: short, actionable rules for PR reviewers.
Maya: yay. can we include concrete JS + Python snippets and note idiomatic param casing per language?
Sam: please include an automated label scheme so reviewers can triage quickly. something like docs/term, docs/snippet, docs/migration.
Lina: i'll draft snippet examples. propose: JS uses camelCase, Py uses snake_case in examples; show both minimal request + expected output.
Sree: terminology note: use 'model variant' for quantized/tuned builds, 'model' for base topology. also prefer 'Dedicated capacity' on first mention, then 'Dedicated'.
Alex: adding those. CI Bot: sample GH Action to auto-label PRs touching /docs or /glossary: ```yaml
name: label-docs
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/labeler@v2
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
Sam: also a minimal checklist for migrations: glossary entry updated, snippet smoke-tested, redirects/links fixed, changelog note.
Maya: include note about token-cost examples: keep tiny and show expected output.
Lina: for snippet smoke tests, add a one-line command in the playbook to run the example locally.
Alex: volunteers? Maya + Sam review the playbook, Lina owns snippets. Sam owns label automation.
Maya: happy to review.
Sam: will take automation + checklist.
Lina: will write examples tonight.
Docs Bot: Playbook PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4332 (labels: docs/term, docs/snippet). Pinged reviewers Maya, Sam, Lina.
Alex: will merge after reviews. thanks everyone :sparkles:
Sree: copying product for alignment.
Maya: quick reminder: keep wording concise, avoid marketing-y phrasing in technical docs.
Alex: noted — playbook will show do/don't examples.
CI Bot: Applied labels to PR 4332.
